fixes.old: but you must tell them you are doing it before doing it
fixes.new: but you must say you are doing it before doing it
fixes.answers: Name the technique before using it: KEPT ("you must tell them").
fixes.why: self-guided: you name it to yourself; there is no other person

fixes.old: Ok, open your eyes and come back up, you can decide
fixes.new: Ok, open your eyes and come back up, feel the room around you, you can decide
fixes.why: lost script step that orients you before you choose

fixes.old: You are going to go to a certain place in your mind, pick a place to go to when you go inside.
fixes.new: Pick a place to go to when you go inside.
fixes.answers: ADDED-CLAIM: "You are going to go to a certain place in your mind... when you go inside." New unconditional instruction to go inside; it sits against the "if it will be of use" opt-out.
fixes.why: takes out the added claim; the published choosing of one scene stays

fixes.old: Who do you need to talk to first?
fixes.new: Who or what needs to talk first?
fixes.answers: "Who or what needs to speak first?": CHANGED. Now "Who do you need to talk to first?": "what" gone, and you address someone instead of letting a voice speak.
fixes.why: script line: the part speaks first, and it may be a what

fixes.old: Trance Depth (if you want to check how deep they are, but you have to tell them you are going to do it before doing it):
fixes.new: Trance Depth (if you want to check how deep you are):
fixes.answers: ADDED-CLAIM: depth check heading says "you have to tell them you are going to do it before doing it." The published asks for naming only for fractionation (P57). "Check how deep they are" also casts it as testing another person.
fixes.why: drops the added rule; the check is on yourself and stays optional

fixes.old: it just might mean that someone is listening.
fixes.new: it just might mean that something is listening.
fixes.answers: "Something may be listening": CHANGED. "Someone is listening" names an agent.
fixes.why: limit on what a response proves; no named agent
an everyday word could set the cue off by accident

fixes.old: Be sure to do this when you are in a good place.
fixes.new: Be sure to do this when you are in hypnosis and in a good place.
fixes.answers: Pair cue with receptive listening during a familiar, welcome hypnotic state: CHANGED. Now "while doing the motion... in a good place"; pairing with the state is gone.
fixes.why: the cue is paired during hypnosis; "familiar with" is already in the next paragraph

fixes.old: or talking about something that could be considered trauma
fixes.new: or thinking about something that could be considered trauma
fixes.answers: Not with a traumatic scene: CHANGED. "Talking about" trauma does not cover a silent scene.

fixes.old: (a good idea to pick an appropriate time and place)
fixes.new: (make sure it is an appropriate time and place)
fixes.answers: Cue meaning is conditional (time set aside, appropriate place, deliberate start): CHANGED. Becomes an instruction; time and place become "a good idea"; "deliberately" gone.
fixes.why: appropriate place is a condition again; "pick the time" keeps the deliberate start; instruction form left

fixes.old: Be sure to change the direction you are going in, or stop this at some point.
fixes.new: You can change the direction you are going in, or stop this at any point.
fixes.answers: I can change direction or finish: CHANGED. Becomes "Be sure to change direction or stop at some point", a duty.
Give it time: LOST. | Gradually shorten when the shortcut helps: CHANGED. "You can always shorten"; "gradually" and "when it helps" gone.
fixes.why: restores patience and the gradual pace; the next clause already keeps the when-it-helps part

fixes.old: Be able to change directions when you are in it.
fixes.new: Be able to change directions or come back up when you are in it.
fixes.why: exit check: coming back must still work

fixes.answers: State your decision while awake: KEPT (now "You can say"; step becomes option).
fixes.why: a step of retiring the cue had become optional

fixes.answers: Cancellation sentence doesn't prove instant removal: CHANGED. "Won't make it go away" says saying does nothing; "instantly" gone.
fixes.why: saying it only fails to remove it at once, as published

let_stand.item: Purpose is practicing coming back: LOST (script still says "come back up").
let_stand.why: the script still does the coming back and offers the stop

let_stand.item: Defined as returning toward ordinary awareness, then deciding whether to re-enter: LOST.
let_stand.why: the script right after does just this

let_stand.item: "Used openly, it teaches trance has a door in both directions": LOST.
let_stand.why: framing; the script still offers both ways

let_stand.item: Reason, no answer may secretly mean "deeper": LOST (rule stays, reason gone).
let_stand.why: the naming rule stays and can be followed without the reason

let_stand.item: Notice what changes as attention gathers again: CHANGED. "The change that comes over you" presupposes a change; "attention gathers" gone.
let_stand.why: the published also expects something to change; same noticing step

let_stand.item: Attention "may become more gathered": CHANGED. Hedge becomes the instruction "Allow your attention to gather."
let_stand.why: "allow" stays permissive and the usefulness condition is kept

let_stand.item: One simple scene: CHANGED. "Just pick a place" keeps one; "simple" gone, "whatever you want" added.
let_stand.why: still one easy pick; looser wording

let_stand.item: Signals come when the meeting space is ready: CHANGED. Now sent "to let you know" it is ready "to go in to": a go-ahead.
let_stand.why: both make the signal a sign the space is ready; the P67 limit stays

let_stand.item: I will not force it: KEPT ("You don't have to make it happen"; pledge becomes permission).
let_stand.why: "just wait with love and notice" still leaves only waiting, so no forcing or faking

let_stand.item: No instant depth required: CHANGED. "A certain depth" drops speed.
let_stand.why: no depth is required at all, which covers instant depth

let_stand.item: Faster entry doesn't determine what material you can handle: CHANGED. Becomes "Don't use this to go in faster for things you shouldn't be working on yet": a rule on use, limits undefined.
let_stand.why: same upshot: a quicker way in is no license for heavier material

let_stand.item: ADDED: "whatever you want" opens the scene choice beyond the list.
let_stand.why: the scenes were examples; still one place

let_stand.item: ADDED: reason for the driving ban, inward attention when outward is needed. Consistent with P74; no new rule.
let_stand.why: consistent with the ban; no new rule

let_stand.item: ADDED: voice. First-person lines (P60, P64-P66) become "you"; the script now addresses "them".
let_stand.why: "you" still speaks to the listener, who is yourself; both "them" lines are fixed above

let_stand.item: ADDED, none acted on: "at some point in time you can add this"; "Ok,"; "either way is ok"; "sitting in front of"; "where you can see the bottom"; "comfortable"; "come up by itself"; "an entire hand"; "He even did it"; "don't do that!".
let_stand.why: the report marks them none acted on
